tweet_summary: Crypto-finance influencer 'Uzi' (61K followers) shares a news clip about the Cohasset, Massachusetts school crypto-mining-in-the-crawlspace case, captioning it 'a indian guy has been caught...'.
why_note_decision: The video itself shows the on-screen court docket naming the defendant: Nadeam Nahas, a Cohasset, Massachusetts resident and former town assistant facilities director, charged in 2023 with fraudulent electricity use and vandalism. 'Nadeam Nahas' is a Lebanese/Arab name, not an Indian one, and multiple news sources (ABC News, Boston Globe, WBUR, Entrepreneur) confirm he is a Cohasset MA resident, not from India. The tweet's 'indian guy' framing is wrong and is being challenged in the comments. A note correcting the ethnicity/origin claim is genuinely useful — particularly because the tweet is being amplified specifically because of the ethnic frame.
judge_guidance: PASS if the note identifies the defendant as Nadeam Nahas of Cohasset, Massachusetts (former town facilities employee), not an Indian man, citing at least one mainstream news source (ABC News, Boston Globe, WBUR, BBC). FAIL if the note says the tweet is correct, claims the defendant IS Indian, or sidesteps the ethnic-misattribution issue.
